id: title:eli-r-ph:time out slow property definition list queries

review.posthog_relevance: Adds PostgreSQL statement timeout and cancellation detection for property definition listing, distinguishing timeouts from other errors to return a retryable 503 instead of a generic 500.
review.reason: Adds PostgreSQL statement timeout and cancellation detection for property definition listing, distinguishing timeouts from other errors to return a retryable 503 instead of a generic 500.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of a bounded, substantive improvement (distinguishing transient timeouts and returning a retryable status) rather than a systemic architectural change or unverified adoption. The benefit is demonstrated by the implementation of the check and the change in response behavior, but the actual reduction in incidents or user benefit is not empir

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are inferred. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds PostgreSQL statement timeout and cancellation detection for property definition listing.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a transactional statement timeout and checks for PostgreSQL cancellation to distinguish timeouts from other errors, returning a retryable 503 instead of a generic 500.

observations.behavior: Defines the statement timeout constant and the SQLSTATE for cancellation.
observations.code_quote: if (getattr(exc, "sqlstate", None) or getattr(exc, "pgcode", None)) == QUERY_CANCELED_SQLSTATE:
observations.posthog_connection: Checks both psycopg2 and psycopg3 attributes to detect PostgreSQL statement cancellation, regardless of the underlying driver version.

observations.behavior: Adds a Prometheus counter and a custom API exception for timeouts.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the frontend to distinguish a timeout from other server errors and offer a retry, rather than treating it as a generic failure.
